country.odd: Three of these cheeses come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

rows.label: Parmesan
rows.hook: is the hard, granular cheese aged for at least a year and grated over pasta and risotto

rows.label: burrata
rows.hook: has a solid mozzarella shell that is filled with soft shreds and cream

rows.label: Cheddar cheese
rows.description: type of cheese that is somewhat hard and often sharp
rows.hook: takes its name from a Somerset village and is often sharp, with a version coloured orange by annatto

rows.label: paneer
rows.description: fresh cheese common in the Indian subcontinent
rows.hook: is a fresh, non-melting curd made by curdling milk with acid, cubed into curries

rows.label: mascarpone
rows.description: soft Italian dairy product made by acid-heat coagulation of cream
rows.hook: is a rich, spreadable cream product best known as the filling of tiramisu

rows.label: mozzarella
rows.hook: is the stretchy, melting topping that gives pizza its famous cheese pull

rows.label: feta
rows.hook: is a tangy, crumbly white cheese aged in brine and tossed into salads

rows.label: ricotta
rows.hook: is a soft, grainy whey cheese used in lasagna and cannoli filling

rows.label: Gouda
rows.description: Dutch yellow cheese made from cow's milk
rows.hook: is a mild yellow cow-milk cheese that turns harder and sharper with age, often sold in wax-coated wheels

rows.label: Grana Padano
rows.hook: is a hard, crumbly cheese similar to Parmesan but cheaper and less strictly regulated
